titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, CBC News
mainText: Prince Harry, Elton John, and others lost privacy cases against Daily Mail publisher.
France's Marine Le Pen received a fraud conviction upheld with a 15-month ban on running for office.
A woman suspected of involvement in a bomb attack in Monaco was found dead in Ukraine.
Explosions occurred in Damascus during President Emmanuel Macron's visit to Syria.
President Emmanuel Macron of France visited Syria 18 months after the fall of Bashar al-Assad's government.
